protocol: Same-interpreter two-arm bitwise parity over the una.paths surface (alternative_paths + all 8 exported engine primitives). Each scenario: reference arm runs TWICE (determinism control), then the facade arm; the facade 'state' digest must equal the reference 'state' digest bitwise (IEEE-754 bit patterns via struct.pack for floats, WKB sha256 for geometries, dtypes/columns/orderings, exact strings). Scope note (review): a handful of structural fields (turn_probes[*].penalty, net_params_*) are recorded as raw JSON numbers compared by exact == rather than bit patterns — equivalent for every value reachable on this fixture (-0.0/NaN payloads unreachable), everything else is bit- or hash-strict. Sabotage variants prove the comparator selects mutated state. Beyond digest parity, the ALL-paths claim is validated by an INDEPENDENT enumeration: networkx all_simple_paths over the engine's own turn-o scope subgraph with turn costs replicated from raw geometry, compared against the engine's route set and the materialized GeoDataFrame (completion condition, dossier 01). RNG/determinism controls: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 is the operative control; the scenario script's --seed argument is recorded in each digest but consumed by nothing (fixtures are fully deterministic).
